answer: Require every identity to reserve its epoch tasks a day ahead, posting 15 POA per reservation, held until the work is done. A missed slot burns the stake and doubles the next reservation: 15, then 30, then 60 POA. One funding cluster may hold at most three reservations; beyond that, each extra identity pays 10 POA more per reservation. Three auditors verify completions. In an ocean of applicants, one honest agent books one copper-stamped slot and keeps its weight from its knoll, while a farm juggles a reservation per fake, each no-show burning stake and each extra fake raising the surcharge.
